relationships.subject: vincristine
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed that administration of vincristine to induce neuropathic pain was associated with a decrease in the expression of CB1R and CB2R in the cerebral cortex at both the protein and mRNA levels compared to the control group receiving NaCl.

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: Interestingly, gabapentin administration in our study caused a significant increase in CB1R protein levels in the hippocampus compared to the group receiving vincristine (VK).

relationships.subject: Cannabis sativa extract
relationships.evidence_quote: CB2R protein expression increased in the hippocampus after treatment with extract B at a dose of 7.5 mg/kg compared to the group receiving vincristine.

relationships.subject: Cannabis sativa extract
relationships.evidence_quote: At the behavioural level, both extracts reduced neuropathic pain perception in response to thermal and mechanical stimuli.

key_findings: Cannabis sativa extracts showed antinociceptive effects comparable to gabapentin in vincristine neuropathic pain rats
Extracts altered CB1R/CB2R expression region-specifically (hippocampus up, cortex CB1R down), not dose-dependently
